note: Fresh multi-clause holdouts. Gold roles and links are local scoring data, never model prompts. Directed endpoints do not certify visual fidelity.

cases.text: A pump draws water from a tank through a filter into a greenhouse, while a sensor measures the tank level.
A bicycle chain transfers motion from the pedals to the rear wheel while a brake presses against the wheel to slow it.
A student pours sand from a bucket through a funnel into a jar while a scale measures the jar's mass.
As a comet approaches the sun, its icy surface releases gas that forms a tail pointing away from the sun.
A river passes beneath a bridge, turns around a hill, then empties into a lake beside a village.
A bee collects nectar from a flower, carries it to a hive, and a second bee guards the hive entrance.
